name: std::basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::capacity
intro: Returns the number of characters that the string has currently allocated space for.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Capacity of the currently allocated storage, i.e. the storage available for storing elements.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Memory locations obtained from the allocator but not available for storing any element are not counted in the allocated storage. Note that the null terminator is not an element of the std::basic_string.

examples.output:
"Exemplar" has capacity 15.
"Exemplar is an example string." has capacity 30.
"" has capacity 30.
 
Demonstrate the capacity's growth policy.
Size:  Capacity:  Ratio:
16     30         2
31     60         2
61     120        2
121    240        2
241    480        2

summary: Returns the number of characters that the string has currently allocated space for.
